title: HackerEarth: Maximum Borders
description: You are given a table with `n` rows and `m` columns. Each cell is either white '.' or black '#'. Find the maximum number of continuous black cells in any row or column.
constraints:
1 <= n, m <= 100
• Time: O(N * M) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Calculates longest consecutive '#' sequence across rows and columns in O(N*M) time.
